sloka: ब्रह्मोशानाच्युतेशाय सूर्यायादित्यवर्चसे ।भास्वते सर्वभक्षाय रौद्राय वपुषे नमः ।। ६.१०७.१९ ।।
transliteration: brahmośānācyuteśāya sūryāyādityavarcase ।bhāsvate sarvabhakṣāya raudrāya vapuṣe namaḥ ।। 6.107.19 ।।

translations.english: "Namskar to you, the ruler of Brahma, Siva and Vishnu, to you the Sun god, the spiritual dwelling light in solar orbit, the consumer of all appearing in the form of Rudra.
